submit_form.description: Fires when a user submits a form, capturing the form type and loan application status at the destination URL.

loanApplication.description: Records the current state of a loan application including its completion or processing status.

select_content.description: Fires when a user selects or views page content, including page metadata, user profile, and privacy consent categories.

page.description: Contains page-level attributes such as page type, category, name, URLs, language, and geographic region.

user.description: Holds user profile information including language preference and returning visitor status.

privacy.description: Tracks privacy consent categories and the domains for which consent has been granted.
